title: Pack failure isolation
description: When a pack fails, the core and other packs continue running.
expected_behavior: Pipeline failure in one stage stops only that pipeline. The Event Bus isolates handler errors. The factory registry returns None for failed packs without crashing.

test_steps.action: register a pack whose handler raises an exception
execute a separate pipeline with successful handler
register a bad event handler that raises
test_steps.expected: bad handler error logged, other handlers still receive event

test_steps.action: attempt to load a pack that doesn't exist
